mapper.sql: id, original_name, stored_name, stored_path, file_size, file_checksum, parser_version, file_type, sheet_name, headers, total_rows, exam_year, status, processed_rows, success_rows, failed_rows, error_message, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM import_file ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM import_file ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO import_file (original_name, stored_name, stored_path, file_size, file_checksum, parser_version, file_type, sheet_name, headers, total_rows, exam_year, status, created_at) VALUES (#{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{storedPath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileChecksum}, #{parserVersion}, #{fileType}, #{sheetName}, #{headers}, #{totalRows}, #{examYear}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE import_file SET status = 'IMPORTING', processed_rows = 0, success_rows = 0, failed_rows = 0, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PREVIEWED', 'IMPORT_FAILED')
